triples.tail_surface: The coupling might be heated to facilitate the fitting
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 加热联轴器以辅助安装
triples.evidence_text: NOTE: If the coupling is fitted on the assembled pump, take care that you do not damage the bearing by pressing the coupling too hard. The coupling might be heated to facilitate the fitting.

triples.tail_surface: the shaft must be supported at the opposite shaft end while the coupling is pressed into place
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 压装联轴器时支撑轴的另一端
triples.evidence_text: If the coupling is fitted before assembling the pump, the shaft must be supported at the opposite shaft end while the coupling is pressed into place.

triples.tail_surface: record the vertical gap as reference value for later inspections
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 记录垂直间隙作为后续检查的参考值
triples.evidence_text: Hint: After bearing replacement (or on a new pump) record the vertical gap as reference value for later inspections.

triples.head_surface: vertical gap (paint thickness not considered) between bearing bracket and coupling is less than 1 mm
triples.head_canonical_zh: 轴承支架与联轴器间垂直间隙小于1mm
triples.tail_surface: pump ball bearing(s) shall most likely be replaced
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 泵球轴承可能需要更换
triples.evidence_text: If the vertical gap (paint thickness not considered) between bearing bracket and coupling is less than 1 mm the pump ball bearing(s) shall most likely be replaced.
